sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं सर्वाः प्रकृतयो भृशम् ।मूर्धभिः प्रणता भूमौ गतसत्त्वा इवाभवन् ।। ७.१०७.४ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghaveṇoktaṁ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo bhṛśam ।mūrdhabhiḥ praṇatā bhūmau gatasattvā ivābhavan ।। 7.107.4 ॥

translations.english: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, all the subjects greatly bowed their heads to the ground, as if they had lost their very life.
